Stephen Curry - Out: Curry (rest) won't play Sunday against the Clippers, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

Kristaps Porzingis - Out: The Warriors are exploring potential trades involving Porzingis (personal), who remains away from the team indefinitely while dealing with ongoing health concerns, Anthony Slater of ESPN.com reports.
Moses Moody - Out: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.
Jimmy Butler III - Out: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.
Obi Toppin - Out: Toppin (back) is out for Sunday's game against the Nets, Alex Golden of SI.com reports.
T.J. McConnell - Out: Indiana recalled McConnell (hamstring) from the G League's Noblesville Boom on Saturday.
Ivica Zubac - Out: Zubac (ankle) will remain on the inactive list for Sunday's game against the Nets.
Johnny Furphy - Out: Furphy (knee) is practicing with the G League's Noblesville Boom, per Alex Golden of SI.com.
Ben Sheppard - Out: Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.
Tyrese Haliburton - Out: Haliburton (hamstring) will miss at least the next two weeks of action, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Yanic Konan Niederhauser - Out: Niederhauser (foot) had his third-year team option picked up Thursday by the Clippers, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.

Max Strus - Out: Strus (foot) is making progress but is set to miss at least one more week, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.
Bradley Beal - Out: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.
Jordan Miller - Out: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.
Adou Thiero - Out: Thiero (knee) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Raptors.

Paolo Banchero - Out: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Noah Penda - Out: Penda was diagnosed with a partially torn right hamstring Saturday, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

Kawhi Leonard - Out: Leonard (knee) is expected to be sidelined for at least three to four weeks, Chris Haynes of NBA TV reports.
Nate Bittle - Out: Bittle (foot) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Magic, Cody Taylor of USA Today reports.

Ryan Poehling - Injured Reserve: Poehling (knee) is expected to miss 6-8 weeks with an MCL sprain.
Taylor Hall - Out: Head coach Rod Brind'Amour said Thursday that Hall (undisclosed) will miss a few more games, Chip Alexander of The Raleigh News & Observer reports.
